tools.name: get_program_info
tools.description: Call this when the user asks what Desert Road Catholic is, what it costs or how it works. Returns an overview: what it is, cost (free), 2027 dates, the six stages, what registration includes, the website signup link, and key links. Example: "Tell me about Desert Road Catholic."

tools.name: get_day
tools.description: Call this when the user asks about the reading, date or stage for one of the 90 days. Returns the date, Exodus reading, stage and opening prayer. Pass a day number (1-90) or a calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). With neither, uses today's date in US Eastern time. Example: "What is today's Exodus 90 reading?

tools.name: list_stages
tools.description: Call this when the user asks about the six stages or wants the whole reading plan. Returns the six stages of the 90 days, with their days, start dates, opening prayers and every day's Exodus reading. Example: "What are the six stages of Exodus 90?"
